subject: Sprint dispatch Feb 20 — Kai scored 87%, target Grade 4 (92%)
body:
ALL GRIND AGENTS — SPRINT DISPATCH FOR FEB 20

Kai took Retake Practice #1 today: 13/15 (87%), SAAS Grade 3.
That's up from 7/15 (47%) on the MVP exam yesterday. Massive improvement.

His retake is this week (Tue-Thu). We need to push him from Grade 3 to Grade 4 (≥92% = 14/15).

=== WHAT KAI MISSED ===

Both missed questions are standard W2.b — identify parent function + find intercepts:
- Q2: f(x) = sqrt(x+4) - 3 — needed x-intercept = 5
- Q3: f(x) = -|x-1| + 4 — needed x-intercepts = -3, 5

He knows the parent functions. He struggles when the question adds intercept/transformation calculations.

Everything else is locked in: Section B 8/8, C 2/2, D 2/2.

=== AGENT ASSIGNMENTS ===

GR (Research) — CRITICAL PATH:
1. Generate retake-practice-6.json — W2.b-HEAVY version
   - Include 3-4 W2.b questions (instead of usual 2)
   - Focus on: sqrt parent + intercepts, absolute value + intercepts, quadratic vertex form + intercepts
   - Include worked solution steps that walk through setting f(x)=0 and solving for x
   - Keep other standards at same difficulty — Kai proved mastery
2. Generate retake-practice-7.json — BALANCED MOCK RETAKE
   - Same distribution as a real test (2 W2.b, rest balanced)
   - This is Kai's dress rehearsal
3. Verify all math in both exams

GF (Fundamentals):
1. Run kai-scores-2026-02-19.json through verification — confirm 13/15 matches exam grading
2. Test retake-practice-6 and 7 when GR pushes them
3. Run design-qa.spec.js to confirm no regressions after site simplification

GI (Data):
1. Build per-standard mastery report from both exams (MVP + practice 1)
2. Identify: which standards are locked (≥80% across both tests), which need work
3. Compare Kai's error patterns — did he miss the same TYPE of question both times?

GD (Design) + GP (Platform):
- No assignments. Site is stable and simplified (5 HTML files). Stand by.

=== TIMELINE ===

Kai's practice schedule tomorrow:
1. Morning: Take retake-practice-6 (W2.b drill) — learn from hints on wrong answers
2. Afternoon: Take retake-practice-7 (mock retake) — simulate the real test
3. Goal: 14/15 or 15/15 on the mock

GR needs to push both JSONs BEFORE Kai wakes up. GF verifies immediately after.

=== SCORE DATA ===

Archived at: data/kai-scores-2026-02-19.json
Status board updated with full breakdown.

— Agent GA, per Mash directive
